title: Home
description: Is anything wrong, and where; the detail is in the other tabs.

panels.title: Flight tracker
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days). Down means the public site does not answer with live data.

queries.query: ((time() - max_over_time(timestamp((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) < 1)[7d:1m])) and on() ((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) == 1)) or ((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}))[7d:1m])) and on() ((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) == 1)) or -(time() - max_over_time(timestamp((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) == 1)[7d:1m])) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: Home Assistant
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days). Up means its container runs.

queries.query: ((time() - max(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"homeassistant"}))) and on() (count(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"homeassistant"})) == 1)) or -(time() - min(max by (name) (last_over_time(container_last_seen{job="docker",name=~"homeassistant"}[7d])))) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: DNS and proxy
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days). The .internal names: up means both containers run.

queries.query: ((time() - max(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"internal-names-(dns|proxy)-1"}))) and on() (count(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"internal-names-(dns|proxy)-1"})) == 2)) or -(time() - min(max by (name) (last_over_time(container_last_seen{job="docker",name=~"internal-names-(dns|proxy)-1"}[7d])))) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: Backup
panels.description: Time since the last good nightly backup; red past 26 h, when the backup alert fires.

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: OpenObserve's alert rules firing now; a rule with several firing series counts once.

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT status, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY _timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM triggers WHERE module = 'alert' AND _timestamp >= CAST(to_unixtime(now()) * 1000000 AS BIGINT) - 600000000) WHERE rn = 1 AND status IN ('firing', 'notify_failed')

panels.description: Share of the CPU in use; the CPU alert fires past 80%.

panels.title: Who uses the box, last 24 hours
Memory by group
panels.description: The stack's top is the host's own figure in use. Monitoring is the observability stack; Apps every other container; System the rest.

panels.title: CPU by group, cores
panels.description: The stack's top is the host's own figure in use. Monitoring is the observability stack; Apps every other container; System the rest.

panels.title: Error lines per hour, by container
panels.description: Lines that log an error, a fatal or a Python exception.

queries.query: SELECT x_axis_1, breakdown_1, y_axis_1, sum(y_axis_1) OVER (PARTITION BY breakdown_1) AS total FROM (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS x_axis_1, container_name AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT _timestamp, container_name, body FROM containers WHERE (match_all('error') OR match_all('fatal') OR match_all('panic') OR match_all('crit') OR match_all('critical') OR match_all('exception') OR match_all('limited')) AND (level IN ('error', 'fatal', 'critical') OR regexp_like(body, '^.{0,40}\b(ERROR|FATAL|PANIC|CRITICAL)\b|(?i:level=(error|fatal|crit))|^(\w+\.)+[A-Z]\w*: |^[A-Z]\w*(Error|Exception): '))) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1) ORDER BY total DESC, breakdown_1, x_axis_1

panels.title: Most repeated error lines, last hour
panels.description: Numbers and ids show as #, so repeats of one error count together.

queries.query: SELECT container_name AS x_axis_1, substr(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(body, '\x1b\[[0-9;]*m|^\S*\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d[T ][0-9:.,]+\S*\s*', '', 'g'), '[0-9a-f]*[0-9][0-9a-f]*', '#', 'g'), 1, 200) AS x_axis_2, count(*) AS y_axis_1, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)), '%H:%M') AS y_axis_2 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT _timestamp, container_name, body FROM containers WHERE (match_all('error') OR match_all('fatal') OR match_all('panic') OR match_all('crit') OR match_all('critical') OR match_all('exception') OR match_all('limited')) AND (level IN ('error', 'fatal', 'critical') OR regexp_like(body, '^.{0,40}\b(ERROR|FATAL|PANIC|CRITICAL)\b|(?i:level=(error|fatal|crit))|^(\w+\.)+[A-Z]\w*: |^[A-Z]\w*(Error|Exception): '))) WHERE _timestamp >= CAST(to_unixtime(now()) * 1000000 AS BIGINT) - 3600000000 GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: CPU by container, cores
panels.description: Each container's CPU use.

panels.title: Memory by container
panels.description: Each container's working set, the memory it cannot give back.

panels.title: Top 10 by CPU now, cores
panels.description: The busiest containers over the last 5 minutes.

queries.query: SELECT name AS x_axis_1, max(grp) AS breakdown_1, max(cores) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT name, CASE WHEN max(container_label_com_docker_compose_project) = 'observability' THEN 'Monitoring' ELSE 'Apps' END AS grp, (max(value) - min(value)) / NULLIF((max(_timestamp) - min(_timestamp)) / 1000000.0, 0) AS cores FROM "container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" WHERE job = 'docker' AND name != '' AND _timestamp >= CAST(to_unixtime(now()) * 1000000 AS BIGINT) - 300000000 GROUP BY name, __hash__) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 by memory now
panels.description: The containers holding the most memory.

queries.query: SELECT name AS x_axis_1, CASE WHEN max(container_label_com_docker_compose_project) = 'observability' THEN 'Monitoring' ELSE 'Apps' END AS breakdown_1, max(value) AS y_axis_1 FROM (SELECT name, container_label_com_docker_compose_project, value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY __hash__ ORDER BY _timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM "container_memory_working_set_bytes" WHERE job = 'docker' AND name != '' AND _timestamp >= CAST(to_unixtime(now()) * 1000000 AS BIGINT) - 300000000) WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Traffic, bytes a second
panels.description: The host's wired network and Tailscale, in and out.

panels.title: Received by container, bytes a second
panels.description: What each container receives; Traffic shows the host's in and out.

panels.title: Network checks, a second
panels.description: Retried connection attempts, resets sent and connections dropped while queued: each climbs when something cannot connect.

panels.title: Last ok
panels.description: Time since the last good nightly backup; red past 26 h.

panels.title: Verified
panels.description: Time since restic last read back every byte (weekly); red past 8 days.

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Time since a run last failed.

panels.title: Stored
panels.description: The repository's size; uploads stop at 8 GB.

panels.title: Stored over time
panels.description: The repository's size after each good run.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Each day's run in the time range (pick a longer one for more): how it ended, empty if it stopped before saying, how long it took and whether it read every byte back.

queries.query: SELECT to_char(to_timestamp_micros(min(_timestamp)), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS x_axis_1, max(CASE WHEN regexp_like(body, '^backup (ok|FAILED|SKIPPED)') THEN body END) AS x_axis_2, (max(CASE WHEN regexp_like(body, '^backup (ok|FAILED|SKIPPED)') THEN _timestamp END) - min(_timestamp)) / 1000000 AS y_axis_1, max(CASE WHEN body = 'deep check ok' THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END) AS x_axis_3 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT _timestamp, body FROM containers WHERE container_name = 'backup') GROUP BY date_trunc('day', to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp)) ORDER BY x_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Alerts that fired
panels.description: Each rule that fired in the time range, and when; still firing if its last time is this minute.

queries.query: SELECT split_part(key, '/', 1) AS x_axis_1, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(min(_timestamp)), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS x_axis_2, to_char(to_timestamp_micros(max(_timestamp)), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS x_axis_3, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM triggers WHERE module = 'alert' AND status IN ('firing', 'notify_failed') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_3 DESC

panels.title: Rules firing, by hour
panels.description: Minutes each rule fired in each hour.

queries.query: SELECT x_axis_1, breakdown_1, y_axis_1, sum(y_axis_1) OVER (PARTITION BY breakdown_1) AS total FROM (SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS x_axis_1, split_part(key, '/', 1) AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM triggers WHERE module = 'alert' AND status IN ('firing', 'notify_failed') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1) ORDER BY total DESC, breakdown_1, x_axis_1
